decisions.decision: Replace CLR shared-object identity with world-local positive Int64 IDs and a persisted monotonic allocator. Never reuse removed IDs. Initial synthetic IDs are assigned once in XYZ order; restored IDs are never regenerated from position or list order. No session ID/epoch is durable entity identity.

Use explicit relative voxel members plus an XYZ anchor; retain transparency separately from occupancy. Cube retains source reverse-exclusive/inclusive endpoints and X/Y/Z enumeration. Empty footprints cannot represent placed entities. Unplaced vehicles remain separate P5 actor state.

Use immutable graphs with validation before publication; add/replace/remove preserve old graph and allocator on failure. Remove retains the allocator. Cell lookups distinguish outside/vacant/occupied; the outside sentinel has no durable ID and is never reusable. No desktop global World or callback/delegate serialization.

Checked Int32 spatial endpoints/volume and Int64 ID/revision arithmetic extend P1-SPATIAL-001. Domain graphs are bounded to 65536 total cells/entities; the canonical reference remains 8–1024 rails in H<=64,V<=128,Z<=16. Bounds apply to actual voxel members, including Z; no source footprint is inferred from art dimensions.

Exact ordinal whole-profile matching: ruleset, content version and duplicate-free exact pack ID/version/SHA-256 set. Pack order is irrelevant. No ranges, hash fallback, silent overrides or cross-pack contribution lookup. Synthetic reference pack v2 contains only normal-rail recipes normal0..normal11. Bundled/optional pack import/loading remains P2 under its own identities.

Protocol 3 common envelopes remain; canonical reference-spatial-4 requires entities, track entityId, and changed-entity/explicit-removal delta collections. Prototype fields stay absent and saves stay rejected. Content reference-spatial-content-2 and reference-spatial v2 catalog hash change with recipe/footprint metadata.

Save 5 adds rail owner IDs and complete entity graph/allocator while retaining clock/random state. Only Save 5 is parsed/written under ONLINE-SAVE-002; Save 4 joins retired rejection fixtures. Exact graph/profile validation completes before replacement. Rejected checkpoints remain protected.
